item.title: AfriForum urges communities to prepare for extreme spring weather
item.description: VAAL TRIANGLE - The civil right organisation, AfriForum, called on communities and municipalities to brace against extreme weather conditions this spring. The organisation says the National Disaster Management Centre’s latest seasonal risk weather forecast report needs to be taken seriously, and the necessary preparations and contingency plans must be put in place. item.title: Vanderbijlpark SAPS investigating Marikana double murder and house Robbery
item.description: VANDERBILJPARK - The Vanderbijlpark SAPS is investigating a shocking double murder and house robbery that rocked the Marikana squatter camps on Saturday evening. Two men were fatally shot in their yard by three armed attackers. The suspects then stormed the home of one victim’s wife, demanding cash and cellphones. item.title: Traditional healer found with human skull linked to grave desecrations in Vanderbijlpark
item.description: VANDERBIJLPARK - A 36-year-old man from Tshepong, who identified himself as a traditional healer, has been arrested after being found in possession of a human skull. The suspect was caught on Saturday, 6 September 2025, during routine patrols at the Vanderbijlpark Cemetery by security contracted by the Emfuleni Local Municipality. item.title: Mkhwanazi talks about Armand Swart’s assassination during inquiry
item.description: VEREENIGING - KwaZulu-Natal Police Commissioner, Lieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, has taken the Madlanga Commission of Inquiry back to the assassination of Vereeniging engineer, Armand Swart. item.title: AfriForum is ontevrede dat die regering in die geheim wysigings aan die Wet op Vuurwapenbeheer wil deurvoer
item.description: VAALDRIEHOEK - Die burgerregteorganisasie AfriForum beskuldig die regering daarvan dat hy in die geheim by Nedlac probeer om wysigings aan die Wet op Vuurwapenbeheer deur te voer sonder inspraak van burgerlike samelewing of vuurwapeneienaars. item.title: Sebokeng Police arrest woman accused of kidnapping newborn after two-week search
item.description: SEBOKENG - Sebokeng SAPS arrested a woman accused of kidnapping a 13-day-old baby after a two-week manhunt, bringing relief to the child’s mother and the wider community. The incident began on 29 August 2025 when the mother, while shopping in Evaton, met a woman who introduced herself as Nthabiseng from Orange Farm. item.title: Emfuleni Ethics Committee fails to act against ANC Councillor accused of selling municipal stands
item.description: VAAL TRIANGLE - The DA in Gauteng says the Emfuleni Ethics Committee has failed to meet even once in 6 months, nor has it taken action against an ANC Councillor for allegedly illegally selling municipally owned stands to residents and behaving with gross negligence in his role. item.title: Die land se paaie en grensposte was gister besonders besig
item.description: VAALDRIEHOEK - Die land se paaie en grensposte was gister besonders besig weens vakansiegangers wat teruggekeer het huis toe ná vakansie. item.title: Higher Education minister says VUT’s fraud scandal won’t affect 2026 academic year
item.description: VANDERBIJLPARK - The Minister of Higher Education, Buti Manamela, has assured Vaal University of Technology students that he will not allow the recent exposure of fraudulent qualifications to compromise the 2026 academic year at the Vanderbijlpark university. The higher learning institution is currently at the centre of a major scandal. It involves a syndicate selling fraudulent degrees and registrations to foreign nationals since 2018.
